name: Hosea (King of Israel)
title: The Last King of Israel
summary: Hosea, son of Elah, became the last king of Israel after killing Pekah. He became a vassal under the Assyrian king Shalmaneser, but when he sought help from Egypt, he was imprisoned and Samaria was besieged and conquered – marking the end of the Northern Kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Becomes King of Israel
keyEvents.description: Hosea, son of Elah, conspired against Pekah, killed him, and became king in his place.

keyEvents.title: The Fall of Samaria
keyEvents.description: When Hosea broke his vassal loyalty and sought help from Egypt, the Assyrian king imprisoned him and conquered Samaria, and Israel was taken into exile.
